current.headline: Sync engine in progress
current.summary: Offline editing works locally; the conflict-resolution pass for multi-device sync is the current focus.
current.nextAction: Land last-write-wins merge for plain-text notes, then design the richer merge strategy for checklists.

phases.title: Project setup
phases.summary: Repository, build tooling, and CI scaffolding.
phases.confirmation: CI runs lint, typecheck, and tests on every push.
evidence: GitHub Actions workflow green on main
README quick start verified on a clean checkout

phases.title: Local note editor
phases.summary: Create, edit, and delete notes stored on-device with full offline support.
phases.confirmation: Manual test plan covering create/edit/delete/reorder all pass with the network disabled.
evidence: Offline test plan run on 2026-07-30, 14/14 steps pass

items.title: Rich text editor core
items.summary: Bold/italic/lists/checkboxes backed by a local CRDT document.

items.title: Local persistence layer
items.summary: Notes survive app restart via IndexedDB, migrated automatically from the v1 schema.

phases.title: Multi-device sync
phases.summary: Notes edited on one device appear on another, with conflicts resolved automatically where possible.
phases.confirmation: Two devices editing the same note offline both converge to the same content within 5 seconds of reconnecting, with no data loss for non-conflicting edits.
evidence: Sync transport (WebSocket + REST fallback) passes its integration test suite

items.title: Sync transport layer
items.summary: Push/pull note changes over WebSocket with a polling fallback when the socket is unavailable.

items.title: Conflict resolution
items.summary: Last-write-wins for plain text; a structural merge for checklists is still being designed.

items.title: Sync status indicator
items.summary: Per-note badge showing synced / syncing / offline / conflict states.

phases.title: Sharing and collaboration
phases.summary: Share a note with another account, with read-only and edit permission levels.
phases.confirmation: A shared note edited by a collaborator shows the edit to the owner without a manual refresh.

items.title: Shareable links
items.summary: Generate a link that grants read-only or edit access to a single note.

items.title: Live presence
items.summary: Show which collaborators currently have a shared note open.
